usageNotes: Exists solely for PVE API compatibility — PDM does not manage individual nodes directly, so this endpoint always returns null rather than a node list. Use cluster-level or resource-specific endpoints (e.g. Ceph cluster, auto-install) to query PDM-managed infrastructure. No privileges are required and no parameters are accepted.
tips: Returns null, not an empty array — callers should guard against a null response rather than iterating the result.
This endpoint is safe to call for connectivity testing since it requires no privileges and has no side effects.
